answer: Admission prices the funding path, so extra names cost more. A joiner traces its inbound river and mints one unsellable jade; jade k locks k*k*2,000 POA idle 20 epochs (first 2,000, tenth 200,000). Each epoch a public beacon posts a 32-byte probe due in 30s; a unique signature seats the jade. A late, copied, or two-hop-linked river burns 620 POA and voids every jade on the path. Honest cost: 2,000 POA; 20 clones on one river lock 5.74 million, 800 first jade need 1.6 million, vs ~150 POA. Weakness: fresh wallets; merge two-hop rivers before pricing and slash the cluster on a missed beacon.
